_note: DOCUMENTATION ONLY — Railway deprecated config-as-code (railway.json) in Oct 2026 and its API now refuses to set a configFile. The bookings-refresh service in project gregarious-art has these values set DIRECTLY on the service instead. Editing this file changes nothing; change the service. Kept because the tests assert these values, so the intended config stays recorded and checked.
_why_two_hours: Railway cron is UTC and does not follow the clocks. 08:30 UTC is 09:30 London in BST; 09:30 UTC is 09:30 London in GMT. The redundant run is harmless because the bookings pull upserts.
